text: Bitcoin's modest 2.6% decline has held it near historical highs, but Ethereum's steeper 5.3% drop signals weaker conviction in altcoins and a rotation toward BTC dominance now at 59.5%. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral (53) with a 7-day decline, suggesting caution is building despite healthy $60.7B trading volume, indicating traders are reassessing rather than panicking.
